description: This file is a shell script library for setting up and managing an HTTP server (like Apache or httpd) for testing purposes. It includes functions to start and stop the server, configure SSL, enable HTTP/2, handle webDAV and SVN modules, and perform related test setup tasks.

methods.name: start_httpd
methods.description: Initializes and starts the configured HTTP server for testing.

methods.name: stop_httpd
methods.description: Stops the running HTTP server started for testing.

methods.name: prepare_httpd
methods.description: Prepares the server environment including configuration files and SSL setup if needed.

methods.name: install_script
methods.description: Writes a script file into the HTTP server root directory.

methods.name: enable_http2
methods.description: Enables HTTP/2 support in the test HTTP server configuration.

methods.name: enable_cgipassauth
methods.description: Enables CGIPassAuth module if the server version supports it.
